sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA -----

For the Petitioner : Mr. Baban Prasad, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shree Prakash Jha, A.P.P. .....
Order No.05/ Dated:19.04.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending her arrest in connection with Women and Child Protection Hussainabad P.S. Case No. 11 of 2022 instituted under Sections 323, 328, 307/34, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per F.I.R, allegation is that from the very inception of the marriage deceased was being harassed and assaulted on account of nonfulfillment of additional demand of dowry.
It is alleged that in the month of July, 2022, informant's daughter was administered poison by her husband, father-in-law and present petitioner, due to which she started blood vomiting.
Instead of getting any medical treatment they left her at the house of informant.
On 11.08.2022, in the course of treatment at higher centre, informant's daughter died.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that petitioner is the gotni of the deceased who was married with one Sarfaraj Ansari in the year 2021.
It is submitted that petitioner is not involved in the alleged offence and she had no connection with the family affairs of the husband and wife.
It is further submitted that other co-accused, namely, Sarfaraz Ansari has been granted regular bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in B.A. No.249 of 2023 vide order dated 06.02.2023.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the gravity of offence and severity of punishment and direct involvement of the petitioner in the alleged serious offence, I am not inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner, which stands rejected.
Petitioner is directed to surrender before the court below and pray for regular bail, the learned court below shall consider the same on its own merits, without being prejudiced by this order.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
